requirements.name: hf
requirements.evidence: Check the hf CLI is installed: which hf. If not, pip install -U huggingface_hub

requirements.evidence: Check the user is logged in: hf auth whoami ... hf auth login

requirements.evidence: hf repos create / hf upload / hf spaces logs
